newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cabarrus County, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cabarrus County, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, Fourth Floor, Room 411, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1385 until 11:00 o'clock a.m., North Carolina time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day for the purchase of $49,000,000 General Obligation School Bonds, Series 1997 of the County of Cabarrus, North Carolina, dated February 1, 1997 and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption) annually, February 1,

$2,500,000 2010, $3,400,000 2011 to 2017, inclusive, and $2,200,000 2018. Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to such bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919/733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form. The Bonds will be delivered on or about February 11, 1997.
